title: Evaluator applicability missing ArtifactType.PASSAGE
affectedInvariant: Evaluators must support canonical PASSAGE payload
reproduction: PassageWordCountEvaluator.metadata.target_artifact_types did not include PASSAGE; GroundingFidelityEvaluator did not include PASSAGE
fix: Added ArtifactType.PASSAGE to target_artifact_types of PassageWordCountEvaluator and GroundingFidelityEvaluator; added PassageStyleEvaluator for style profile and structural invariants

title: Silent passage truncation at sentences[:10]
affectedInvariant: Full passage grounding coverage across all sentences
reproduction: Unsupported claim at sentence 11 evaluated to PASS due to hardcoded sentences[:10] slice
fix: Removed sentences[:10] truncation; iterate all sentences of passage with coverage tracking

title: Self-grounding fallback when sourceText missing
affectedInvariant: Independent approved source provenance required; no self-proving passage
reproduction: When sourceText was empty, ref_text defaulted to passage_text, resulting in false PASS on completely ungrounded claims
rootCause: ref_text = source_text or passage_text fallback in GroundingFidelityEvaluator
fix: Enforced strict source provenance: resolve from payload or context.input_dependencies; if absent, fail closed with SOURCE_INSUFFICIENT

title: Aligned claim bypassing unaligned factual sentences
affectedInvariant: Every factual sentence must be independently verified
reproduction: When claims list had 1 aligned claim, remaining unaligned factual sentences were never extracted or evaluated
rootCause: if not claims_to_check and passage_text conditional only checked sentences when claims list was empty
fix: Always extract and evaluate all passage sentences alongside any explicit proposal claims

title: Rhetorical label bypass of semantic checks
affectedInvariant: Generator-proposed rhetorical tags cannot waive factual validation
reproduction: Tagging an assertion with rhetorical=True could allow unverified claims to escape scrutiny
rootCause: Absence of explicit non-bypass rule for rhetorical claims
fix: Explicitly retain and evaluate all claims regardless of generator-proposed rhetorical labels

title: Blind slicing words[:900] in length repair
affectedInvariant: Length repairs must respect sentence and paragraph boundaries within [720, 915]
reproduction: PassageSentenceRepairer chopped passages blindly at word 900, creating broken mid-sentence fragments
fix: Replaced with sentence-aware trimming: scans sentence boundaries from the end to find clean cut within [720, 915]; raises RepairExecutionError if unfeasible

title: UNMEASURED_OUTCOME unhandled in passage repair
affectedInvariant: Modal/causal replacement does not validate unmeasured outcomes without evidence
reproduction: PassageSentenceRepairer handled CAUSAL_OVERSTATEMENT but lacked typed escalation for UNMEASURED_OUTCOME
rootCause: No dedicated handler for UNMEASURED_OUTCOME in _repair_impl
fix: Added typed RepairExecutionError escalation for UNMEASURED_OUTCOME when source material is unverified

title: Missing input_dependency_refs binding in BaseEvaluator
affectedInvariant: Runtime validation requires result.input_dependency_refs to match artifact.parent_refs
reproduction: LoopRuntime raised ValueError('Evaluator result does not bind exact target/parents/version') and entered EVALUATOR_ERROR
rootCause: BaseEvaluator.evaluate did not populate input_dependency_refs from artifact.parent_refs before returning
fix: Added input_dependency_refs binding in BaseEvaluator.evaluate for all raw results and error evaluations

title: Router V2 route synthetic fallback and early NDJSON bypass
affectedInvariant: Selected V2 route must execute V2 composition and fail closed on insufficient source; never execute legacy loops
reproduction: router.py synthesized placeholder facts for source < 50 chars and streamed legacy _stream_section on Accept: application/x-ndjson before is_v2 check
rootCause: Premature NDJSON early return and synthetic string multiplication fallback in router.py
fix: Moved is_v2 check ahead of NDJSON branch; return typed SOURCE_INSUFFICIENT on source < 50 chars; stream V2 events on NDJSON; require exact accepted dependencies from store

title: Token exhaustion from redundant paragraphs array in generation prompt
affectedInvariant: Passage generation prompt must fit within 3000 max tokens
reproduction: Model was required to duplicate full passage in both passage and paragraphs JSON keys, exhausting 3000 completion tokens on long academic topics
fix: Removed redundant paragraphs array schema from passage generation prompt; compute paragraphs cleanly via double-newline splitting in post-processing

title: Missing dynamic length feedback on regeneration attempts
affectedInvariant: Regeneration attempts must steer passage length toward [720, 915]
reproduction: If attempt 1 was undersized (<720w), attempt 2 received identical prompt without length feedback
rootCause: PassageGeneratorAdapter did not supply length feedback on version > 1
fix: Added length_feedback to PassageGenerator.generate informing model of prior draft length and targeting 780-840 words

title: Passing evaluations on newer artifact versions failed to resolve earlier version blockers in ledger
affectedInvariant: Evaluator PASS on replacement artifact version resolves issues of checked codes on earlier versions
reproduction: Version 1 had 703 words (out of bounds); Version 2 was repaired to 761 words (PASS); blocker stayed OPEN in ledger causing MAX_VERSIONS failure
rootCause: BaseEvaluator.evaluate did not populate resolved_issue_fingerprints from context.open_issues for matching evaluator_id and checked codes
fix: Populated resolved_issue_fingerprints on passing evaluation for checked codes affecting earlier versions of the artifact
